description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored when the vertical-slice cut in section 2 brought this skill into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the materialise request in English and German, including the phrasings the description names. Near-misses are the ticket neighbours the skill's own When-to-use table routes elsewhere (refine-ticket, estimate-ticket) plus authoring the roadmap itself (roadmap-writing, named as upstream). Counterexamples guard the word 'ticket' in a support context and a plain to-do list.

queries.q: materialise tickets for road-to-faster-ci so we can start building
emit tickets for this plan, one per step, with blocked_by wired up
I want a YAML ticket bundle under agents/tickets for the onboarding roadmap
mach Tickets aus der Roadmap für Phase 2
split T-004 into two smaller tickets and tighten its acceptance criteria
queries.note: an existing ticket being refined or split → refine-ticket, which this skill's When-to-use table names

queries.q: how many story points is T-007?
queries.note: estimating a single ticket → estimate-ticket, also named in the When-to-use table

queries.q: write a roadmap for moving the build to the new runner
queries.note: authoring the roadmap is the upstream step → roadmap-writing; there is nothing to materialise yet

queries.q: reply to the customer's support ticket about the failed invoice
queries.note: the 'ticket' homonym — a helpdesk conversation, not a work item

queries.q: give me a quick to-do list for cleaning up my desk
queries.note: a list of tasks with no roadmap and no bundle; guards against triggering on task-listing in general
